agent_explanation: Ceiling boundary collision injects energy: body approaches ceiling at ~15 m/s and rebounds at ~35 m/s, more than 2x speed, tripling kinetic energy. Even with e=0 the rebound still gains energy (409J vs ~220J initial), so restitution damping is not applied correctly and positional correction/impulse at the top wall adds outward velocity instead of removing it. Limiting the impact (lower initial vy so no ceiling hit within 626 steps) prevents the violation.
